about.metaDescription: Meet Alexan Production — one team handling both the digital and the visual side of your project.
about.title: One team for both the code and the camera
about.subtitle: We started as a small group tired of coordinating three vendors to finish one piece of work.
about.storyParagraph1: Alexan Production began with a photographer shooting products for online stores, who kept running into the same problem: clients had beautiful photos on a slow website, or a finished website with no decent images to put in it.
about.storyParagraph2: So we assembled a team that could do both. Today clients have a single conversation with us — concept, photography, editing, code, and support after handover.
about.value1Body: Price ranges are on the website from the start. Nothing appears on the invoice that was not discussed.
about.value2Body: Source code, master files, and usage rights are all yours. We never lock a system to force you back.
about.value3Title: We do not vanish at delivery
about.value3Body: Every project includes a support period, and we still answer questions after it ends.
about.teamTitle: The people you will work with
about.teamSubtitle: A small team doing the work themselves, not an agency passing it along.
